subject: Launch readiness: final timing, enablement & exceptions for Atlas Health
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Launch readiness: final timing, enablement & exceptions for Atlas Health

Team —

We need to lock the final launch cadence for Atlas Health and confirm owners for docs/enablement and any carve-outs. External procurement is targeting end of January; that pushes us to either 2/1 or a staggered approach. Outstanding items:

- Final release date (prod traffic start)
- Enablement slots (training + runbook walkthrough)
- Docs ownership (Dev Docs, Integration checklist, SRE runbook)
- Exceptions we need to surface to Sales (rate limits, feature flags, SLA deviations)

I attached the latest mutual action plan (Atlas_MutualActionPlan_v2.xlsx). Please reply with: (A) your recommended release date, (B) any hard blockers, (C) who will take each doc.

Goal: make a consolidated ask to Lisa/Procurement by EOD Thursday PST so they have comfort to sign.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Program Manager, Launch Operations
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0183

Attachment: Atlas_MutualActionPlan_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet stub, 28KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Launch readiness: final timing, enablement & exceptions for Atlas Health

Thanks Olga — quick answers from Product/Enablement side:

A) Recommended release date: 2028-02-01 (soft launch: limited tenants + feature flag; full traffic by 2028-02-15). The Feb 1 date aligns with Atlas procurement wanting Jan signatures — gives us 3 weeks for gated rollout.

B) Hard blockers: two items that might push us: (1) final SSO certs from Atlas (they said by 1/18), (2) detailed retry/backoff guidance for their integration team (we can ship on 2/1 with a heavier doc).

C) Docs ownership:
- Dev integration guide: Marissa Cole (owner)
- Integration checklist (customer-facing): Neha Kapoor (owner)
- SRE runbook & rollbacks: Dylan Brooks (owner)
- Quickstart + sample app: Marissa + Eng docs reviewers

Enablement slots: propose two 60-minute sessions next week (1/17 & 1/24) 11:00–12:00 PST. We can record and drop in the Drive link.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Product Manager, Developer Experience
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 13:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Launch readiness: final timing, enablement & exceptions for Atlas Health

Quick capacity note — thanks for the summary.

We can support a Feb 1 soft launch but need to lock these infra/ops items by 1/20:
- Dedicated pod sizing: I propose starting with 2x A100-equivalent slots with autoscale to 4x for peak onboarding.
- Fallback plan: if onboarding spike > 2x expected, we will route new tenants to the lower-cost model (buffered) for 72 hours while we spin capacity.
- Observability: add an early-warning alert for 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 10m and latency p95 > 850ms.

Attached a simple capacity table for Q1 (capacity_table_q1.csv). If Marissa signs off on the phased ramp we can commit.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Product Infrastructure
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

Hi Olga / team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple of items from our side:

1) Procurement timeline: we expect to complete internal approvals by 1/26; legal wants the final SOW + runbook.
2) SSO certs: IT team confirmed they will send certs by 1/18 — that aligns with your timeline.
3) Can you confirm whether the Feb 1 soft launch will allow us to test at production scale (i.e., simulated traffic), or will it be limited to a small subset of Atlas testers? Our ops lead prefers simulated traffic to validate end-to-end.

Also please provide the integration checklist and quickstart ahead of 1/17 session so our engineers can prep.

Best,

Subject: Re: Launch readiness: final timing, enablement & exceptions for Atlas Health

Thanks — I took the docs items and outlined a minimal checklist below (I will drop drafts to Drive by EOD Monday):

Docs checklist (minimal MLP for Feb 1 soft launch):
- Customer-facing integration checklist (PDF + embedded code snippets) — owner: Neha
- Dev integration guide (markdown + sample app) — owner: Marissa (with eng reviewers)
- SRE runbook (rollbacks, incident playbook, contact list) — owner: Dylan
- AB test/feature flag instructions (how to enable/disable features per tenant) — owner: Neha
- Post-launch quality eval plan (prompt sets & regression guards) — owner: Marissa + Research

Enablement plan: 1/17 internal dress rehearsal + 1/24 customer session (60m each). I will create a short agenda: 10m overview, 30m technical walkthrough, 15m Q&A, 5m next steps.

Exceptions to surface to Sales (to put in SOW):
- We will allow one-week leniency on SLAs during initial tenant ramp (documented with expected degradation thresholds).
- Rate limit: standard plan limits apply; Atlas can opt-in for elevated limits once they complete the performance validation.

I'll upload drafts here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AtlasLaunchDocs

-Neha

Date: Fri, 14 Jan 2028 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Launch readiness: final timing, enablement & exceptions for Atlas Health — consolidated decisions

Thanks all — consolidating decisions and next steps here so Procurement/Atlas has a clean ask: 

Decisions (final):
- Target soft launch date: 2028-02-01 (limited tenants; scheduled simulated traffic window available by request). Full ramp to production traffic starting 2028-02-15 contingent on SSO certs and post-soft-launch metrics.
- Docs: owners confirmed (see threads). Neha will publish the customer-facing checklist by 2028-01-16; Marissa will publish dev guide draft by 1/19; Dylan will publish runbook by 1/20.
- Capacity: Vivek to provision 2x baseline pods with autoscale to 4x; early-warning alerts will be in place before soft launch.
- Exceptions to record in SOW: 7-day SLA leniency during initial ramp; explicit rate-limit escalation path.

Action items (owners + deadlines):
- Neha: upload integration checklist + agenda for 1/17 session (due 1/16)
- Marissa: dev guide draft + sample app (due 1/19)
- Vivek: capacity confirmation and alert rules (due 1/20)
- Dylan: SRE runbook (due 1/20)
- Olga: prepare consolidated SOW & send to Lisa/Procurement by 1/17 (I'll attach runbook and mutual action plan).

Lisa / Procurement — please confirm if that timeline matches your review cycle (1/26 approval as mentioned). If you need a production-scale testing window on 2/1, let us know by Monday so we can schedule simulated traffic.

I'll upload the runbook (Final_Runbook_Atlas_v1.1.pdf) once Dylan completes his section.

Thanks — feel free to reply with any last-minute blockers.

Olga Petrov
Program Manager, Launch Operations
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0183
